Dylan Park: Quick heads-up 1: we're aiming to publish the benchmark blog + short FAQ on 2026-06-15 09:00 PT. This is EMBARGOED. Draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/bench-june
Dylan Park: Need three confirmations by 08:30 PT: 1) CEO quote final ok with legal; 2) syndication windows for partners (Dev.to, HN, Partner.A); 3) CDN assets uploaded and checksum-verified.
Harper Lee: I can own syndication timing. Proposed windows: Dev.to 09:05 PT, HN 09:10 PT, Partner.A 09:30 PT. If legal requests changes to the CEO quote, we delay HN by 10 minutes to avoid noise.
Maya Singh: Legal flagged one line in the quote: "unmatched throughput" -> suggest "notable throughput improvements in our tests". CEO prefers stronger language; legal requests the qualifier. CEO can greenlight by 08:15 PT.
PressOps Bot: Draft social posts queued and will hold sends until @Dylan posts GO. I can also attach an embargoed read-only preview link for top outlets at T-3h on request.
ops-bot: CDN sync in progress. Current status: assets uploaded 08:05 PT, checksum OK. Will run link-check at 08:40 PT.
Dylan Park: If legal pushes changes that materially alter claims, we will notify partners and delay HN by 10 minutes. Maya please route final CEO line to legal and paste the approved sentence in this thread.
Maya Singh: Pasting CEO line for approval: "These results demonstrate notable throughput and latency improvements on comparable instance types." legal-bot please confirm.
legal-bot: Suggested edit accepted. Replace "notable" with "measured" for precision: "These results demonstrate measured throughput and latency improvements on comparable instance types." Approve if OK with CEO.
Dylan Park: I'll ping CEO. If we don't have sign-off by 08:20 PT, we delay publish by 30m to ensure legal + CEO alignment. PressOps, prepare note to partners if timing shifts.
PressOps Bot: Prepared partner note template: "Publish window updated to T+30m due to final approvals. We'll share final assets 15 minutes before publish." Will send on Dylan mark.
Harper Lee: Noted. I'll tentatively hold HN to 09:20 PT if we push. Updating syndication sheet now: https://sheets.internal/press/windows-june
Dylan Park: Thanks everyone. Final GO will be posted here at ~08:45 PT after ops health check and CEO sign-off. If anything else pops up, add here and I'll triage. :rocket:
